english:
Passively grants 15% Flinch Resistance.

Dealing or receiving damage at least every 5 seconds builds 'Power of the Son', granting a stack after 12 seconds and reaching 2 stacks after 24 seconds. Once triggered, the Combat Timer extends to 7 seconds.

Power of the Son grants 15%|25% Damage Resistance against PVE Combatants at 1|2 stacks.

Maximum of 2 stacks.

source.text:
4 Piece | Power of the Son

Passively grants 15% Flinch Resist.

While maintaining a state of dealing or receiving damage every 5 seconds:
Grants a stack of Power of the Son after 12 seconds, up to 2 stacks after 24 seconds.
Combat Timer is extended to 7 seconds once triggered.

Power of the Son x1 | 15% Damage Resist against Combatants.
Power of the Son x2 | 25% Damage Resist against Combatants.
